people.gloss: Treads the snow to seek the plum (đạp tuyết tầm mai)
people.role: Founder and head of Ngạo Tuyết Phái (1105): the plum-blossom sword, the iron town of Thạch Khẩu, and the rule of no Metal, no sword
people.appearance: A lean, hard old man with a frost-burned face and bare feet in every season, who looks at a visitor's hands before their face.
people.backstory: Lăng Đạp Tuyết was born in Hàn Mai Thôn in 1068, in the village named for the winter plum that bloomed over a buried child (A069). At seventeen he followed a wandering sword sage, Tư Không Hạc Niên (tu_khong_hac_nien), for three winters, and came home with a sword and a thread of Metal in his root. In 1105 he founded the school above his village after a winter of watching the plum bloom through the snow, and swore it to the pines (V051). He teaches that a blossom needs a hard branch. Since 1105 he has turned away every child without Metal at the plum gate, Ninh Hàn Chi (ninh_han_chi) among them. In 1161 the last families left the ore town of Thạch Khẩu Trấn, where a tiger was taking miners (V053). The next spring the tiger took his daughter Lăng Nhược Mai (lang_nhuoc_mai) on the mountain road. He hunted it to Hổ Khiếu Cương and killed it, and took the empty town and its iron for the school. His sworn brother Trác Thiết Cán (trac_thiet_can) forged him a sword from it. He is 132, Trúc Cơ, with sixty years left and no Golden Core.
people.wants: A Golden Core before his years run out, and his best sword kept at home whatever the sage was promised.
people.secret: He was born with no Metal at all. On the third winter Tư Không Hạc Niên gave him a Spirit Root Fruit (Linh Căn Quả), and the thin Metal it put in his root he raised by marrow-washing over sixty years. Every child he turns away at the plum gate is the child he was. The fruit's price was the first disciple he would ever make, and at this new year the sage wrote for Phó Ngạo Sương. Lăng wrote back that his first disciple was his dead daughter Lăng Nhược Mai, so the tiger has paid, and asked Trác Thiết Cán to recut the year on the tang of Phó's first sword.

tree.intent: Metal sword crits first, Wood bleeds second: he fights with no companion and blooms when he is most hurt.
tree.targets_note: Sword route, the Autumn Scythe and Keen Edge for Metal sword crits, then the long walk to Falling Leaves for the Wood bleed: five petals on a hard branch.

build.note: The plum-blossom swordsman: five petals on a hard branch and a last blossom at the worst moment.

people.role: Smith of the iron town and the founder's sworn brother; forges every sword the school carries
people.appearance: A short, enormous miner's son in a striped tiger-hide coat, with forearms like the mountain's ore.
people.backstory: A miner's son of Thạch Khẩu Trấn who left the ore town at twenty to follow the swordsman of Hàn Mai, and swore brotherhood with Lăng Đạp Tuyết (lang_dap_tuyet) when the school was founded in 1105 (V051). When the town emptied in 1161 (V053) he wanted to go home. Lăng took it a year later for his daughter's sake, and Trác built the forge in the old smelting house and tanned the tiger's hide. He forges every sword the school carries and cuts the year into its tang. He is the only person who tells Lăng no, and this summer he did.

ties.note: asked him to recut a tang this summer; he said no
a miner's grandson from his own town
he forged her first sword in 1125 and is forging her a travelling one
outer disciple of the forge; quenches the school's blades
seam-finder: walks the old mines of the mountain for iron the forge can use

tree.intent: A Metal body and heavy blows; he fights like he forges.
tree.targets_note: Sword route, then the Vajra Body's skin and bones: a smith's Metal body.

build.note: A smith with an axe for a hammer. Wears a sword, as the plum gate's canon asks.

people.wants: To see Phó Ngạo Sương go to the sage with a sword worth the price.
people.secret: Lăng asked him this summer to recut 1125, the year on the tang of Phó's first sword, so that his dead daughter would stand first. He refused, and he is forging Phó a travelling sword from the last good iron in the seam.

people.role: The founder's first disciple and the school's best sword; the price the sword sage wrote for
people.appearance: A tall weaver's daughter with a plum-branch hairpin and a long white scar on her neck from a tiger's claw.
people.backstory: A Ma Bố Thôn girl Lăng Đạp Tuyết (lang_dap_tuyet) took as his first disciple in 1125; Trác Thiết Cán (trac_thiet_can) forged her first sword that year. She reached Trúc Cơ in 1160 and became his equal, which he has never quite forgiven, and a school whose head is Trúc Cơ can take her no higher. She was on the mountain road with Lăng Nhược Mai (lang_nhuoc_mai) in 1162 when the tiger came, and lived. She teaches the inner gate and would open the plum gate to children without Metal if she were head.

ties.note: taught her as a girl; equals since 1160
died beside her on the mountain road
the smith who forged her first sword and says out loud she is the best in the school
inner disciple of the first disciple
master of the ice drills: holds the inner-gate test on the frozen ore tailings

tree.intent: Sword crits and Wood bleeds; she fights cleaner than her master.
tree.targets_note: Sword route, Ten Thousand Edges, then her master's Falling Leaves for the Wood bleed: faster and cleaner than him.

people.wants: A master past Trúc Cơ, which the school cannot give her.
people.secret: Every month she slips Phí Tầm Mai (phi_tam_mai) a short sword-form to send with her letters to Ninh Hàn Chi in the pines, so the girl turned away at the plum gate is learning the plum blade by post.

people.role: Keeper of the plum gate at the old seat above Hàn Mai
people.backstory: He keeps the plum garden above Hàn Mai where the school began (V051), tests every child's root at the gate, and stood beside Lăng Đạp Tuyết (lang_dap_tuyet) when he turned Ninh Hàn Chi away. Ninh Hàn Chi (ninh_han_chi) was one of the children he sent away in sleet who would have been taken in sun, and he keeps no record of which.

ties.note: outer disciple at the Plum Gate; tends the grave trees

people.appearance: A plum twig behind one ear; he sniffs the sky before he speaks.

people.backstory: A Vân Biên Thôn boy who copies Lăng Đạp Tuyết (lang_dap_tuyet) down to the bare feet; he wants to duel the pines' Nhiếp Vãn Đào before he is thirty.
people.appearance: Goes barefoot in the snow, and shows off the frostbite blister on each heel.

people.gloss: A wild goose in the cold
people.role: Inner disciple of Phó Ngạo Sương
people.backstory: From Phó Ngạo Sương's (pho_ngao_suong) own village of weavers; she practises the five petals on the frozen ore tailings every dawn.

ties.note: inner disciple of the ice drills

people.appearance: Weaver's calluses across her right palm, and a pearl-grey sash she keeps spotless.

people.role: Outer disciple and smith's boy; his family were miners of Thạch Khẩu
people.backstory: His grandparents left Thạch Khẩu Trấn in 1161 (V053) for Thạch Lâu Thôn; he came back to the empty town to work Trác Thiết Cán's (trac_thiet_can) bellows.

ties.note: outer disciple; carries the lamp for the seam-finder
outer disciple of the forge; quenches the school's blades

build.note: Wears a sword, as the plum gate's canon asks.

people.appearance: One shoulder higher than the other from the bellows, and ears that stick out through the soot.

people.role: Outer disciple at the plum gate; the one Hàn Mai child of her generation with Metal
people.backstory: She passed the plum gate on a thin streak of Metal the same winter her friend Ninh Hàn Chi (ninh_han_chi) failed it, and she sends her letters in the pines every month.

ties.note: turned away the winter she was taken
outer disciple at the Plum Gate; tends the grave trees

people.appearance: Wears a plum petal pressed flat in a locket; her step startles easily.

people.role: Inner disciple who duels the road wardens for practice
people.backstory: A terrace-farmer's son of Tầng Điền Thôn who walks a season to Tùng Hạ Thị every few autumns to pick fights with Tuần Tùng's wardens, chosen by the colour of their sashes, and last time he wrecked a pie-seller's stall in the brawl; Phó Ngạo Sương (pho_ngao_suong) has stopped paying his fines.

ties.note: the warden head who beat him with a staff
inner disciple of the first disciple

people.appearance: A fresh cut under one eye every month, a crooked grin, and he cannot stand still in the queue for his fines.

people.cause: killed by the spirit tiger of Thạch Khẩu on the mountain road, at 42
people.role: The founder's daughter; died to the tiger that emptied Thạch Khẩu Trấn
people.backstory: She went up to the emptied ore town in the spring of 1162 to see if the tiger that drove the miners out (V053) had gone; it had not, and her father killed it on Hổ Khiếu Cương a month later (N-ngao_tuyet-01).

ties.note: with her on the road

people.appearance: Remembered as a girl with her father's frost-burned cheeks and a short sword worn on her back like a school satchel.
